title: SPIKE GO: answer benchmark probes from the DAG via task context read, not RAG
summary:
Risk-spike 59fc18e1.../3 verified (live daemon, 2026-06-16): the "our way" arm — answer QA probes by reading the frozen DAG instead of retrieval-time RAG — is a GO for the ISOLATED absolute-path workspace. Confirmed end to end in bench/agent-memory/{smoke.js,smoke.py,probe_seed.js}.

WORKING FUNNEL (isolated workspace, all HTTP, all workspace-targeted via ?workspace / body.workspace):
1. POST /overlay/note {workspace, title, summary, category} x N session notes (NO force — force suppresses autowire + the dup signal). Returns {key:"note:<id>"}.
2. Mint the probe as a TASK node by dropping a file-drop stub at <CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA|~/.claude/orchestrator>/tasks/<workspaceKey(ws)>/<harness>/<id>.json = {id, subject, status:"pending"} (lib/filedrop-tasks workspaceKey/stubFile). Daemon adopts it for ANY workspace within ~1.5s. Key = "<harness>/<id>".
3. Drive ingest with POST /overlay/status {workspace, key:<probe>, status:"not_ready", summary}. Do NOT use status:"in_progress" (trips the dispatcher/unwired claim gate, routes/overlay.js:140-159). The first-vec ingest funnel (routes/overlay.js:240-250) is gated only on (summary set OR no vec), so a non-claiming status write triggers embed -> autowireNewTaskWholeGraph -> markEagerJudge. autowire seeds NOTE candidates as from=note,to=probe at weight 0/judged:false (daemon.js:1408-1411), above SEMANTIC_AUTOWIRE_THRESHOLD=0.55.
4. POST /judge/verdict {workspace, verdicts:[{keepEdge:{from:"note:<planted>", to:<probe>}}]} (body MUST wrap verdicts:[...]). keepEdge promotes weight 0->cosine, judged:true (lib/judge.js:580-590).
5. READ: GET /task/context?key=<probe>&workspace=<ws> (reads ?workspace only, not body). Returns {dependencySummaries:[{key, via:"context", weight, summary, ...}]}. Confirmed: returns ONLY the kept planted note at weight 0.785-0.816 with the planted answer token in summary; irrelevant/distractor notes ABSENT (depRefs filters weight-0 edges, daemon.js:1526).

PROVISIONAL/RAG-FILL: with a single strong candidate
